headline: Standard Bank Pilots Mortgages for Homeowners Without Title Deeds
summary: Standard Bank launched a pilot lending program in South Africa to extend credit to township and rural homeowners lacking formal property title deeds for housing expansion and solar power installations.
why: Standard Bank is Africa's largest lender by assets. Expanding collateral underwriting into untitled informal property markets could unlock consumer credit growth.

impacts.name: Standard Bank Group
impacts.why: The unsecured mortgage pilot expands retail loan reach into previously unserved township segments.
